Name: Quieter cat dog and keg
Author: bluegun222
Description:
This is a mod to make a few ambient soundFX quieter as theyannoyed me a little bit.
This mod changes the Dog, Cat and the Keg to be a little quieter to fit the
chilled out theme and brilliance that is Stardew Valley.

As this is a sound mod it replaces the Wave Bank.xwb file so it has no compatibility
with other sound mods which replace that file.
You can add these sounds to another wave bank.xwb if you know how, if not go
here for a tutorial: learning how will take 15mins

https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sound-modding-tutorial-discussion-redux.127661/

As such I have included the .Wav files I changed for anybody to add to their
pack, all permissions given.

Installation
--------------------------------------------------------

Back up this file
Installdirectory:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew
Valley\Content\XACT\Wave Bank.xwb

then Replace with mine.

Uninstall
--------------------------------------------------------
Replace mine with your backup

Notes
--------------------------------------------------------
I didn't bother making this a content patcher mod because the file is so big
and there is no need for another duplicate and additional load time.
